verdict.rationale: Lithic is an API platform, so scoped API credentials are a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents API keys with restricted permissions, read-only keys, or per-agent credential scoping. Authorization Rules and spend limits do scope card spending at the program, account, or card level, but that is an adjacent control over transactions, not least-privilege API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
